text:
sarah (support): FYI customer AcmePay is getting repeated 400s from our /v1/generate when using structured JSON mode. They say it worked last week and suddenly started failing after a deployment. Full error: `Invalid structured output: field 'id' expected number but got string`

maya (support): Oof. Do we have a quick repro from the customer or logs? Any example payload and response?

sarah (support): They sent this minimal repro (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"invoice-gen-v2","input":{"id":"12345","amount": 1200.5,"paid":"false","status":"COMPLETED"},"output_format":"json_schema","schema":{"id":"number","amount":"number","paid":"boolean","status":{"type":"string","enum":["completed","pending","failed"]}}}'
```
Response: `400 Bad Request` + JSON error: `{\"error\":\"Invalid structured output: id type mismatch (expected number)\"}`

sarah (support): Note: `id` is quoted (string), `paid` is quoted (string), and `status` enum casing is uppercased; all three are tripping strict validation. Customer says prior to 2026-02-15 deploy we accepted coercion.

support-bot: [alert] Customer AcmePay high error rate (50+ errors/min) flagged. Case opened: #INC-2026-118.

lee (eng-platform): Which runtime and model variant were they on? Could be a kernel change that tightened JSON validation on certain model shims. Any `model_version` in the payload?

sarah (support): They used `invoice-gen-v2` (no explicit version), region eu-west-1, host header shows requests routed to `runtime-3b-quant`. I grabbed a small request log and upstream response.

ian (eng-ml): Quick Q: are we running stricter schema coercion by default now? There was a change to `strict_json` default for structured outputs in the last batch, but it should have been opt-in. Investigating.

maya (support): Customer is blocked — their ingestion pipeline de-serializes and fails. Also they reported billing anomaly: failed requests still showed as billed for full token usage. They need either a quick workaround or a rollback.

ian (eng-ml): Short-term workaround for the customer: 1) pre-coerce on client side: send numeric ids as numbers (no quotes) and booleans as `true/false` (not strings). 2) If they can't change client, they can set the header `X-Redwood-Structured-Coerce: true` or query `?coerce_structured_output=true` — that will re-enable legacy coercion behavior for their tenant (we can flip on per-tenant). I'll enable it for AcmePay now.

lee (eng-platform): I'll confirm whether that header/flag is respected by `runtime-3b-quant`. If not, we'll patch routing to add a transform. Also investigating billing: failed responses should not be billed for generator tokens; they might be charged for input tokens only. Logging bug filed: BILL-482.

sarah (support): Customer accepted header workaround but asked for a permanent fix. They want consistent behavior across model rollouts and less brittle enum handling (case-insensitive).

ian (eng-ml): Plan: 1) revert unintended strict default (if present) within 2 hours or enable per-tenant coercion until patch. 2) Add a permissive enum match option (case-insensitive) behind `enum_match=loose`. 3) Add unit tests that cover quoted numbers, quoted booleans, and enum-case variants. I'll create a PR and tag @lee for deployment gating.

maya (support): I've told AcmePay we enabled `coerce_structured_output` for their tenant and that'll be visible immediately. They're still concerned about the billing spike; please confirm BILL-482 triage ETA.

lee (eng-platform): Triage update: BILL-482 assigned to finance infra, ETA 24h for initial root-cause. Runtime config: we had a guard that accidentally flipped strictness for unpinned models during a rollout. Rolling back guard now.

ian (eng-ml): Opening internal ticket ML-977 with repro steps and sample payload. Attaching failing log lines and model routing info. Will follow up in the incident thread.

sarah (support): Thanks — customer is unblocked for now. Please keep me posted, I'll update the case once billing is cleared and we have the runtime fix. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Incident #INC-2026-118 updated: `coerce_structured_output` enabled for tenant acmepay.

ian (eng-ml): Follow-ups: I'll add a small compatibility shim so quoted numeric strings are auto-coerced when `coerce_structured_output=true` is present, and we'll make the strict default explicit per-tenant in the future.

maya (support): Noted. Closing loop with AcmePay in 2h unless new errors appear.

lee (eng-platform): Patch rolling to runtime-3b-quant in eu-west-1; watch windows 20m.

sarah (support): Closing thread for now — will re-open if customer complains.
